items.title: Mother told to book appointment to give birth to baby who had died
items.summary: Newcastle Hospitals NHS Trust apologises for care it says "fell short of the standards" expected.

items.title: Hackers target refrigerators in new cyber attacks
items.summary: Cyber hackers have targeted fridges and freezers in supermarkets in several European countries including Ireland – causing temperatures to increase and food to spoil.

items.title: Hunt for attackers after Halloween party stabbings
items.summary: Three boys aged 16 and two aged 17 were taken to hospital with serious injuries on Saturday night.

items.title: Rare ant colony stolen from nature reserve in Devon
items.summary: Conservationists have said the theft of a rare ant colony from a nature reserve in Devon is a "significant loss" which "sets back years" of hard work by staff and volunteers.

items.title: Mahmood to set out changes to settlement rules for legal migrants
items.summary: The home secretary will lay out a revised proposal for changing when migrants can claim permanent residency later.

items.title: Ministers to hold urgent talks with Poundland chiefs
items.summary: The government is to hold an urgent meeting with Poundland bosses amid growing recriminations over the discount retailer's ownership.
